Math · For teachers

Math standards map: GED® and CCR

Which LearnGED lessons teach each GED® Assessment Target, Mathematical Practice, and College and Career Readiness Standard.

How to read this map

  • works on it The lesson teaches the target as the GED® test asks it.
  • foundation The lesson builds a skill the target needs. Level 1 starts with whole numbers; the test uses rational numbers (fractions, decimals, and negative numbers).
  • The Mathematical Practices are habits of reasoning. Many lessons practice them; the map lists the ones each lesson works on most.

College and Career Readiness (CCR) Standards for Adult Education

The GED® targets describe what the test asks. The CCR Standards describe the steps before it, by level (A to E). Level 1 lessons work mostly on Levels B and C. The list shows only the CCR standards that LearnGED lessons teach so far.

CCR Standards for Adult Education and the LearnGED lessons that teach them
CodeLevelStandardLearnGED lessons

4.NBT.3CUse place value understanding to round multi-digit whole numbers to any place.Lesson 1.1
4.NBT.4CFluently add and subtract multi-digit whole numbers using the standard algorithm.Lesson 1.2

4.OA.4CFind all factor pairs for a whole number in the range 1–100. Recognize that a whole number is a multiple of each of its factors. Determine whether a given whole number in the range 1–100 is prime or composite.Lesson 4.1 (complement)
6.NS.4CFind the greatest common factor of two whole numbers less than or equal to 100 and the least common multiple of two whole numbers less than or equal to 12.
